notes.en: [[character:evelyn]] needs 80% CRIT Rate to activate her Additional Ability. With the 25% CRIT Rate from her Core Passive, she needs at least 55% from gear to operate optimally.
Target stats at level 60: ATK 2,600 to 3,400+, HP 10,000+, DEF 800+, CRIT Rate 80 to 100% (including the Core Passive) and CRIT DMG 160 to 200%+.
[[character:dialyn]] is a near perfect match: she raises the Stun DMG Multiplier (where most of Evelyn's damage lands), extends the Stun and converts Chain Attacks into extra Ultimates.

[[character:lighter]], [[character:trigger]], [[character:ju-fufu]], [[character:koleda]] and [[character:norma]] are all strong Stunners for different reasons. Lighter gives quick Daze and large buffs.

[[character:seed]] buffs Attack agents who deal the main damage. [[character:astra-yao]], [[character:yuzuha]] and [[character:lucy]] are generalist supports for any team, with Astra Yao providing Quick Assists, extra Chain Attacks and healing.
The W-Engine ranking was calculated with [[character:dialyn]] (Yesterday Calls) and [[character:sunna]] (Thoughtbop). Percentages are relative to her signature.
